title: Installation is not successful
body:
The plugin doesn't install at all. I tried with two Jmeter version 5.6.3 and 5.4.1 on Windows 11 professional 64 bit version 24H2. It appears in "Available plugin" tab but it never appears in "Installed Plugin" tab.
Every installation attempt returns with following remaining activities in Plugin manager.
Uninstall plugin: jpgc-plugins-manager 1.0.8
Install plugin: jpgc-plugins-manager 1.10

Java version: 1.8 update 441 64bit

Following error appears in Jmeter. It appears dependency on Java version.

2025-03-31 17:02:27,982 WARN o.j.r.Plugin: Unable to load class: org.qainsights.jmeter.ai.gui.AI
java.lang.UnsupportedClassVersionError: org/qainsights/jmeter/ai/gui/AI has been compiled by a more recent version of the Java Runtime (class file version 53.0), this version of the Java Runtime only recognizes class file versions up to 52.0
	at java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass1(Native Method) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass(Unknown Source) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at java.security.SecureClassLoader.defineClass(Unknown Source) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at java.net.URLClassLoader.defineClass(Unknown Source) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at java.net.URLClassLoader.access$100(Unknown Source) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at java.net.URLClassLoader$1.run(Unknown Source) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at java.net.URLClassLoader$1.run(Unknown Source) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at java.security.AccessController.doPrivileged(Native Method) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at java.net.URLClassLoader.findClass(Unknown Source) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at java.lang.ClassLoader.loadClass(Unknown Source) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at java.lang.ClassLoader.loadClass(Unknown Source) ~[?:1.8.0_441]
	at org.jmeterplugins.repository.Plugin.getJARPath(Plugin.java:202) [jmeter-agent-1.0.8-jar-with-dependencies.jar:?]
	at org.jmeterplugins.repository.Plugin.detectInstalledPlugin(Plugin.java:108) [jmeter-agent-1.0.8-jar-with-dependencies.jar:?]
	at org.jmeterplugins.repository.Plugin.detectInstalled(Plugin.java:97) [jmeter-agent-1.0.8-jar-with-dependencies.jar:?]
	at org.jmeterplugins.repository.PluginManager.load(PluginManager.java:86) [jmeter-agent-1.0.8-jar-with-dependencies.jar:?]
	at org.jmeterplugins.repository.PluginManagerMenuItem$1.run(PluginManagerMenuItem.java:38) [jmeter-agent-1.0.8-jar-with-dependencies.jar:?]

Which Java version is recommended? or any other dependency missing?
